meta.what_this_is: Self-assessment of the monitoring artefacts in this repository: the comparison feed, the snapshot store, the delivery log and the published site copies. It answers 'is the monitor running?', not 'did the NFL change anything?'.

status_values.warn: the monitor is working but at least one check is degraded
status_values.fail: the monitor cannot currently be trusted; see checks[]
status_values.unknown: the evidence needed to decide is absent; never reported as ok

meta.what_it_cannot_see: A workflow that is disabled, queued or cancelled by GitHub, a runner outage, or a notification that was accepted by an endpoint and never read. Check the Actions history for attempt-level truth.

headline: Monitor degraded: it is running, but at least one check needs attention.

checks.detail: the upstream source file changed in 3 of the last 3 comparisons; the frozen-field projection changed in none of them (identical-input streak 3), which is the expected state for a scoreboard-only monitor
5 snapshot(s); newest is pinned to upstream commit b8a4c3931e (0.65h old)

all 1 recorded attempt(s) found no webhook configured, so no alert would currently reach a person; delivery is opt-in via the ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL secret, and the Atom feed is the zero-configuration alternative
every published copy of the feed matches its canonical source

irregularities: notification is not configured; alerts reach nobody
next_action: Push notification is not configured, so a detected candidate would reach nobody unless they poll. Either set the ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL repository secret (Slack or Discord compatible) or subscribe to the Atom feed at data/alerts/feed.atom. Until then the honest state is: detection works, notification does not.
